gates.rule: AuthContext requires validated C03 credentials; bind account_id and session_generation; no owner from Client strings.
Decode C02 region variants but do not assume its field1 is authenticated account name.
Create input account name != authenticated login (case-insensitive ASCII canonical) -> deny with no S02(0), draft, Character or Grant; unauthenticated always deny.
Owner+generation pending; C04 atomic one-time commit; C15 only cancels uncommitted draft.
Prove native authenticated C03 no-character -> NewUser UI (or another authenticated native route) and actual C02 account field. Native C02/C04 remain fail-closed.
C02 S02(0) triggers C04 and state1e; C04 S02(0) goes to local UI, not automatic S03; nonzero S02 leads C15.
Server selects valid map/spawn; Client must accept S15/S14/C35/S04/S33; no invented native C25.
S44/C6C Script lifecycle; Server decides first dispatch and quest rules, close is not completion.
